snippet.title: The Last (Hotdog) Stand Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Run your own hotdog stand in this fast-paced food management game! Take orders, make dogs, and keep customers happy as you work to grow your hotdog empire, and restore hotdogs to their former glory. Upgrade your stand, unlock new ingredients, and expand to bigger, busier locations!

The Last (Hotdog) Stand is launching on June 24th 2026, with a demo coming out on May 7th! Wishlist it on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4619190/The_Last_Hotdog_Stand/
